info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-Delete Healthcare Appointments Cancel-v3-spec
info.description: The Cancel Healthcare Appointments API enables providers to manage and remove scheduled appointments efficiently. This endpoint allows authorized users to cancel existing appointments, streamlining appointment management in healthcare systems. Typical consumers include healthcare administrators and booking platforms that require seamless integration for maintaining appointment accuracy and usability. By canceling appointments, organizations can ensure optimal scheduling and reduce no-show rates, ultimately enhancing patient experience.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a previously scheduled appointment. Ensure that the appointment ID is provided in the request to successfully process the cancellation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary data for canceling an appointment. The client must specify the appointment details that need to be canceled.

200.description: Request completed successfully; appointment cancellation confirmed.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelReques.description: The request body for canceling an appointment operation.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.title: Cancel Appointment Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the cancellation request.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the cancellation operation.

state.description: The current state of the appointment after the cancellation attempt.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the cancellation request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the cancellation status.

DeleteHealthcareAppointmentsCancelRespon.description: Response schema for the operation of canceling an appointment.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: User or system that created the cancellation request.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the cancellation request was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was processed automatically or manually.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the audit trail for the cancellation request.
